strategyPoints: Tire management is crucial on this abrasive rallycross surface. Expect to see drivers carefully managing their rubber throughout the heats and finals.
The Joker Lap is a significant strategic element here. Timing your Joker Lap perfectly can gain you valuable track position.
With such a short lap length, the traffic management will be key. Getting caught behind slower cars can ruin your race.
The pit window for tire changes is relatively short, so teams need to be lightning-fast in the pit lane.
Fuel consumption will be a factor, even on this short circuit. Teams will need to carefully calculate their fuel loads to avoid running dry.
The dirt sections are very punishing. Smart drivers will try to conserve their equipment, knowing that attrition can be high.
Starting position is critical here. A good start can give you a significant advantage in the early stages of the race.
The setup of the car is a compromise between grip on the tarmac and stability on the gravel. Finding the right balance is essential for success.
weatherCommentary: The Styrian mountains can bring unpredictable weather. We could see sunshine one minute and rain the next.
The wind can also be a factor here, especially on the jump sections. Drivers will need to adjust their lines accordingly.
If it rains, the dirt sections will become incredibly slippery and challenging. Car control will be paramount.
The sun can be intense here at the Red Bull Ring, which can affect tire temperatures and grip levels.
The forecast is calling for a chance of thunderstorms later in the day. That could really shake things up!
